'''2000 DragonCon tournament (29 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG convention tournament held in DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia on 29 June 2000. It is known from Bill Gordon's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d966">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-6-30-2000d966/ dragoncon-6-30-2000], DeckTech (Bill "BRay" Gordon, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-6-30-2000d966/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 DragonCon Open]].

* '''Date:''' 29 June 2000
* '''Site:''' DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
